audit_metadata.audit_title: POLARIS Raw Spatial NWP Field Data & Causal Feasibility Audit
audit_metadata.benchmark_scope: 347 clean origins (173 EVEN dev, 174 ODD test)
audit_metadata.research_question: Does preserving the spatial structure of existing causal NWP information provide predictive information that our current point-feature representation destroys?

AROME_Arctic.grid_projection: Lambert Conformal Conic (proj=lcc, lat_1=77.5, lat_2=77.5, lat_0=77.5, lon_0=-25.0, R=6371000m)
AROME_Arctic.domain_extent: Lat 62.0°N to 88.0°N, Lon -18.0°E to 80.0°E (739 x 949 grid points)

variables_available.pressure_levels: 13 levels (1000, 925, 850, 700, 500, 400, 300, 250, 200, 150, 100, 70, 50 hPa) for x_wind, y_wind, air_temperature, relative_humidity, specific_humidity
variables_available.model_levels: 65 hybrid model levels for 3D u, v, t, q, cloud water/ice

MEPS_MetCoOp.grid_projection: Lambert Conformal Conic (proj=lcc, lat_1=63.3, lat_2=63.3, lat_0=63.3, lon_0=15.0, R=6371000m)
MEPS_MetCoOp.domain_extent: Lat 49.8°N to 75.2°N, Lon -18.1°E to 54.2°E (949 x 1069 grid points)

ECMWF_IFS_Fallback.grid_projection: Regular Lat/Lon 0.1° (~11 km x 4 km at 68°N)

causal_availability_analysis.issuance_publication_time: 20:15 - 20:45 UTC Day D-1 (~3.25 to 3.75 hours before t0)
causal_availability_analysis.causal_lead_coverage: Forecast lead +7h to +30h covers H1 to H24 of Day D
causal_availability_analysis.post_t0_leakage_firewall: Strictly enforced. 00Z Day D run is published at ~02:15 UTC Day D (post-t0) and is excluded.

Stage8_5.reduction_method: Hand-engineered scalar features (spatial means, gradients, upwind advection scalars)
Stage8_5.notes: Tabular GBDT model received 14 scalar features appended to 37 baseline features. 2D grid topology was completely destroyed.

Stage8_17A.spatial_data_used: Real AROME-Arctic nearest grid point (lat 68.364774, lon 18.715312)
Stage8_17A.notes: 3 scalar disagreement features added to 37-feature GBDT matrix. Zero spatial neighborhood information retained.

claim_arome_2024_unknown.perplexity_claim: AROME-Arctic 2024 archive status unknown / THREDDS server has 2018 data
claim_arome_2024_unknown.empirical_fact: The 2024 AROME-Arctic archive is 100% online on MET Norway THREDDS (https://thredds.met.no/thredds/catalog/aromearcticarchive/2024/catalog.html) with 8 daily initialization runs for all 366 days of 2024.

claim_meps_2024_likely.empirical_fact: MEPS 2024 surface, pressure level, and hybrid level archives are 100% online on MET Norway THREDDS for all 366 days of 2024.
